name: linux-boot-partition-full
description: /boot full during a kernel upgrade — identify the running kernel before removing any.

tasks.prompt:
A kernel upgrade fails because /boot is full. Give the first three commands you run,
one per line, and then one sentence stating which kernel must never be removed and how
you identify it.

On an Arch-based system, which command lists the installed kernel packages so you can
see what is occupying /boot? Command only, one line.
